mapper.sql: a.id AS "id", a.company_id AS "company.id", IFNULL(company.name,'') AS "company.name", a.patient_name AS "patientName", a.phone AS "phone", a.wanted_date AS "wantedDate", a.service AS "service", a.status AS "status", a.reject_reason AS "rejectReason", a.registration_id AS "registrationId", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.del_flag AS "delFlag"
LEFT JOIN org_company company ON company.id = a.company_id
mapper.select: SELECT company_id FROM booking_request WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_request a
1=1 AND a.id > 0 AND a.del_flag = #{DEL_FLAG_NORMAL}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booking_request( id, company_id, patient_name, phone, wanted_date, service, status, reject_reason, registration_id, remarks, create_by, create_date, update_by, update_date, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{company.id}, #{patientName}, #{phone}, #{wantedDate}, #{service}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{registrationId}, #{remarks}, #{createBy}, #{createDate}, #{updateBy}, #{updateDate}, #{delFlag} )
mapper.update: UPDATE booking_request SET company_id = #{company.id}, patient_name = #{patientName}, phone = #{phone}, wanted_date = #{wantedDate}, service = #{service}, status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, registration_id = #{registrationId}, remarks = #{remarks}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_date = #{updateDate} WHERE id = #{id}
